agent_runs.node_description: Queue emails, create CRM tasks, post Slack alerts
Log intervention for future outcome tracking

delta_analysis.historical_context: No historical lessons available for opsgrid tenant (HyDE enabled)
key_insights: Usage drop threshold of 45%+ is reliable early warning signal
Multi-signal convergence (usage + inactivity + tickets) indicates highest churn probability
Structural clustering of at-risk accounts suggests systemic issue rather than isolated account problems
CTO/technical contact routing more effective than ops for critical accounts
Autonomous intervention timing is optimal—no escalation delays observed
recommendations_for_future_runs: Monitor whether 43-day inactivity threshold holds across future cohorts
Investigate root cause of structural similarity cluster (product gap, market shift, competitor activity)
Track conversion rates from CSM outreach emails to measure intervention effectiveness
Establish MRR-weighted intervention priority (high-value accounts may need faster response)
Consider proactive outreach at 30-day inactivity mark rather than waiting for 43+ days

outcome.situation_summary: All 5 accounts with complete data are CRITICAL, representing $17,315 MRR at risk. Average DAU decline is -50.6% with avg 28 days since last login and NPS averaging 2.8. VoltDesk ($10,711 MRR, enterprise) is highest priority with -67.6% DAU drop and NPS=2. 15 accounts lack sufficient data for analysis.
outcome.memory_summary: Processed 5 accounts with 5 critical and 0 at-risk. Primary risk pattern: Usage drop of 45-67% combined with extended inactivity (43+ days) and/or 4+ support tickets. All accounts cluster with 94-97% structural similarity, suggesting shared root cause. MRR range ($292-$10.7K) indicates risk is not tier-dependent. Interventions successfully queued for all 5 accounts with 100% autonomous completion rate—early detection enabled timely CSM outreach without escalation delays. High-value accounts (VoltDesk, NovaWorks) require same urgency as lower-tier accounts.
